Aberdour School is delighted to have been commended in the 'Student Wellbeing of the Year' category in the Independent School of the Year Awards 2026. Congratulations to all of the commended schools and we look forward to hearing who will make it on finalists list in September. Launch of our new website

Head of English chosen as shortlisting judge for Time To Write 2026

Aberdour Celebrates Outstanding Senior School Offers and Scholarship Success
Aberdour Celebrates Outstanding Senior School Offers and Scholarship Success
Aberdour School is proud to celebrate an exceptional year of senior school destinations, with this year’s Year 6 cohort achieving remarkable success across a wide range of leading independent and grammar schools.
Our impressive Year 6 cohort received 71 independent school offers and an exceptional 57 scholarships awarded across academic, sport, music, drama, art and specialist disciplines. In addition, pupils secured places at Sutton grammar schools, with offers from 15 academically selective senior schools overall.
This breadth of achievement is a defining feature of an Aberdour education. Pupils have received offers from a diverse and highly regarded group of senior schools including Brighton College, Caterham School, City of London Freemen’s School, Dunottar School, Epsom College, Reigate Grammar School, RGS Surrey Hills, St John’s Leatherhead, St Teresa’s Effingham, Reed’s School and others – giving families genuine choice in selecting the right next step.
A particularly striking aspect of this year’s results is the range and quality of scholarships awarded. Aberdour pupils secured scholarships across an exceptional variety of disciplines, including academic, art, drama, performing arts, sport as well as innovation and entrepreneurship. Many pupils were awarded multiple scholarships, highlighting both depth and versatility of talent across the cohort.
At the heart of this success is Aberdour’s deeply personalised approach. Each child is supported through a tailored pathway, whether pursuing competitive entrance examinations, scholarship routes, or selective grammar school entry, ensuring that every pupil is prepared not only to succeed, but to thrive.
Our focus is not on a single definition of success, but on finding the right environment for each child. These outcomes reflect a school culture that knows its pupils as individuals, nurtures their strengths, and builds the confidence and character needed for the next stage of their journey.
Once again this is testament to our approach of – Finding the brilliance in every child.
This year’s results continue a strong and consistent pattern, with Aberdour pupils progressing to an incredibly wide range of highly selective senior schools, supported by a preparation programme that is both ambitious and genuinely individual.

Celebrating Excellence - Aberdour School ISI Inspection 2026 Highlights
Inspections at Aberdour
Truly Finding the Brilliance in Every Child
There are moments in the life of a school when something important is confirmed — not just measured, but truly seen. Our most recent Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI) inspection is one of those moments.
What emerges from this report is not simply a set of findings, but a powerful reflection of what makes Aberdour special: children who are confident and thriving, teaching that inspires, and a culture where every child is known, supported and challenged to be their very best.
We are incredibly proud of the findings from our most recent Independent Schools Inspectorate (ISI) inspection, which presents a powerful and affirming picture of life at Aberdour. Within the current framework, this is one of the strongest reports we have seen with the new inspection framework – particularly in terms of the power of the impact on pupils from what we do.
Inspectors recognised the ambition, confidence and care that define an Aberdour education. They highlighted the strength of teaching, the enthusiasm of our pupils and the nurturing environment in which children flourish.
Most notably, our personalised approach to learning was identified as:
This is a rare distinction, awarded to only around one in ten schools, and reflects the exceptional impact of our approach in ensuring every child is both supported and stretched to achieve their very best.
At the heart of this is our belief that every child has their own unique brilliance. Through our personalised approach to learning – including our PAL programme – and our bespoke curriculum (Wonder, Inspire & Discover in Pre-Prep; Create, Innovate & Aspire in Prep), we ensure that each child is known, challenged and inspired.
The report also confirms that Aberdour meets all Independent School Standards across every area inspected.
This latest inspection builds on an exceptional history. In our previous full ISI inspection, Aberdour was awarded the highest possible judgement of Excellent in every category, including:
This consistency reflects a school that is not only performing at a high level, but continually evolving and improving.
We warmly encourage you to explore our ISI Inspection Highlights Booklet 2026, which brings the report to life through key findings and direct quotations from inspectors.
A full copy of the report, along with previous inspection reports, can be found below.

Epsom College Public Speaking Competition
Very proud of our Year 5 team (The Aberdorators) who delivered their speech: ‘Why my dog would make a better football manager’, at Epsom College Public Speaking Competition.
Public speaking is such an important life skill and the judge commented on their ‘comic opening’, ‘calm voice’ and ‘excellent articulation’.
Also impressive was their timing and formal delivery of the roles involved as chair, main speaker and vote of thanks. Well done, team Aberdour!

Discover More
Our School
Our Facilities
Performing Arts
Share on FacebookShare on Facebook
Share on XShare on X
Performing Arts
At the heart of our Prep Hall lies a vibrant hub of creativity and expression, where Performing Arts is brought to life through immersive experiences using a wide range of digital resources. Equipped with professional-grade microphones, a modern music system, and dynamic stage lighting, our performance space offers pupils the opportunity to engage with the arts in an inspiring, fully supported environment.
Backstage, children explore every element of theatre production—from voice projection to stage presence, to controlling lighting and sounds —developing valuable skills that extend well beyond the spotlight. Drama is embedded within the curriculum, with regular sessions dedicated to building public speaking abilities, confidence, and collaborative learning.
We believe Performing Arts is not just about acting—it's about empowering children to find their voice, own the stage, and step into the future with confidence.
Every performance is treated as a significant milestone, with a strong emphasis on quality and aspiration. Our immersive plays and musical productions aim to ignite ambition, allowing each child to dream big and perform with pride. By the time they leave Prep, our children have not only taken part in high-quality shows, but have experienced the energy and discipline of a West End-style performance.
LAMDA is also on offer as an extra-curricular activity after school.
